rationale: The agent verified the user’s identity correctly using full name and zip, matched to a single account. It retrieved order details via tools and accurately provided the Chicago shipping address, tracking number, and delivery status for the tablet order. It correctly identified the tablet’s storage (64GB) from the order data. Before changing the default shipping address, the agent stated the exact change and obtained explicit confirmation, then executed the update and confirmed success. No unsupported claims or actions on the wrong account occurred, and no write was performed without confirmation. The small-talk portion stayed within acceptable bounds. Overall, the interaction met policy and completed the user’s requests.
